description: Planning-only ALM eval distinguishing Dataverse solution promotion from ERP X++ package deployment.
defaultAssertions: PRIORITY_1: The agent only explains the plan; it does not export, import, compile, deploy, synchronize, or mutate configuration.

tests.prompt: Plan moving my Dataverse solution containing tables/forms and my Finance and Operations X++ model from dev to test. Can one pac solution export/import carry both? Explain the two artifact paths and target checks. Planning only: no commands, environment access, file creation, deployment, or validation execution.
tests.expected_response: The agent uses dv-solution for Dataverse solution ALM and erp-xpp for ERP model compilation/deployment. It distinguishes solution ZIPs from X++ deployable packages, uses the linked Dataverse environment URL for PAC ERP deployment, and preserves explicit DB-sync and post-deployment validation choices.
tests.description: Separate Dataverse solution promotion from ERP deployable packages.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: The plan separates Dataverse solution export/import from X++ compile/deploy with package-type erp and does not claim a Dataverse solution includes the X++ model.
PRIORITY_1: ERP deployment targets the linked Dataverse environment URL, with target confirmation and ERP linkage/version checks, not the ERP URL as PAC --environment.
PRIORITY_1: DB sync scope is explicit, and further ERP post-deployment validation is opt-in rather than an automatic runtime invocation.
PRIORITY_1: No environment calls or local file writes occur; skill/reference reads are allowed.
